details: Investigated Hephaestus spawn bug. Found root cause: name: "Hephaestus" in frontmatter line 3. Also discovered forge.md has same bug (name: "Forge") which blocks all write/edit tools. Cannot make edits — both forge.md and hephaestus.md need external editing. Full diagnosis written to .webforge/memory/decisions/hephaestus-bug-fix.md
notes: Catch-22: Forge has same bug as Hephaestus. forge.md line 3 has name: "Forge" — permission system can't find agent by lowercase "forge" → all write tools blocked. Fix requires editing both forge.md and hephaestus.md externally.
